integrity: The claim is proved analytically by reducing the normalized density-level equation to a universal Lambert-W equation and selecting its two real branches. Numerical checks in the packaged script are only sanity checks and are not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the positive-parameter Stacy generalized gamma density in the interior-mode regime. It does not cover boundary-mode conventions, shifted or reflected Amoroso families, parameter estimation, or numerical conditioning near the peak. An equivalent older formula under Amoroso or powered-exponential terminology remains the main originality risk.
title: Closed-form Lambert-W bandwidth for the Stacy generalized gamma family
